# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Stonebridge  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c13 P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029)</sub>
- **Titles:** Schoolma’am  <sub>[v2 c13 P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette Pullen is a young woman who dresses neatly and appropriately for her student and teaching pursuits. She was seen attending social outings in modest attire, such as wearing a sash during a boat outing.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Personality

Odette is steady, sensible, unshakeable, and composed under pressure. She is hardworking, dutiful, pragmatic, unassuming, and widely regarded as a nice and lady-like young woman. Though she finds the routine of teaching somewhat tedious, she takes her obligations seriously and performs her duties conscientiously.

_Sources: [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P8](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0008), [v2 c11 P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)_

## History

Odette grew up in Stonebridge and attended local schooling alongside friends like Nell Harcourt, Opal Pettigrew, and Isolde Pembroke. While out on the Lake of Glassy Waters, she nearly drowned attempting to gather water lilies before being rescued by Mr. Gorham Pullen. She later attended Regent's Academy to complete her teacher training, where she earned top marks in domestic science and displayed notable composure during examinations. Upon qualifying, Odette took a position teaching school in Stonebridge, where she earned the approval of the community and a place on the Inspector's Roll of Honor. As an active community member, she joined the B.V.I.S. committee, took charge of fundraising for the Delford road alongside Tibby Tulk, and provided moral support to Nell Harcourt during deputations. She also took part in leisure outings with her close circle of childhood friends.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c28 P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c13 P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 c14 P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 c14 P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- nearly drowned in the Lake of Glassy Waters before being pulled back by Mr. Gorham Pullen  <sub>[v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068)</sub>
- wept heavily upon the departure of her schoolmaster Mr. Pidgeon despite claiming she would not  <sub>[v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- enacted the role of Guinevere in a play based on Tennyson's Elaine with her friends  <sub>[v1 c28 P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011)</sub>
- attended the town Exhibition multiple times in her youth  <sub>[v1 c29 P13](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0013)</sub>
- studied at Regent's Academy and achieved top marks in domestic science  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- placed on the Inspector's Roll of Honor for her teaching performance  <sub>[v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003)</sub>
